## Glossary

- [Artifact](nodes/term.artifact.md) · VERIFIED · A claude.ai page built from HTML or Markdown. It can be watched, commented on, and given a shared database. See Artifact.
- [Background task](nodes/term.background-task.md) · VERIFIED · A command or monitor that keeps running after the turn ends. See Background time limit.
- [Built-in tool](nodes/term.built-in-tool.md) · VERIFIED · A tool the runtime provides under a fixed name. Permission rules, subagent tool lists and hook matchers all use that name. Example: Bash.
- [Compaction](nodes/term.compaction.md) · VERIFIED · Summarizing older context when the window fills. Hooks: PreCompact and PostCompact. Context budget: Context window.
- [Connector](nodes/term.connector.md) · SESSION · A claude.ai integration, such as GitHub or Gmail, exposed as tools in this session. Example: mcp__github__actions_get.
- [Deferred tool](nodes/term.deferred-tool.md) · SESSION · A tool whose schema loads only after ToolSearch fetches it. Calling it before that fails with an input-validation error. See ToolSearch.
- [Fork](nodes/term.fork.md) · VERIFIED · A subagent that inherits the full parent conversation. See Agent.
- [Harness](nodes/term.harness.md) · VERIFIED · The runtime around the model: the tool loop, permissions, hooks, memory files, settings and integrations. Claude Code is the harness that runs the model....
- [Hook](nodes/term.hook.md) · VERIFIED · A handler the runtime runs at a named event. Handler types: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt and agent (experimental). See PreToolUse and Handler type: command.
- [Matcher](nodes/term.matcher.md) · VERIFIED · The hook field that selects which tool or source an event applies to. See Matcher: empty, star or omitted and Matcher: regex.
- [MCP server](nodes/term.mcp-server.md) · INDEX · A Model Context Protocol server that adds tools, resources or prompts. See MCP overview.
- [Mod](nodes/term.mod.md) · INDEX · A plugin-style extension that can draw panes, add commands, and react to events. See Mods overview.
- [Permission column](nodes/term.permission-column.md) · VERIFIED · In the tools reference, Yes means the tool asks for approval in Manual mode for paths inside the working directory. File-access tools marked No still prompt...
- [Permission mode](nodes/term.permission-mode.md) · VERIFIED · The policy that decides when Claude asks before acting. Example: Permission mode: default.
- [Permission rule](nodes/term.permission-rule.md) · VERIFIED · A ToolName(specifier) entry in an allow, ask or deny list. See Rule form: ToolName(specifier).
- [Plugin](nodes/term.plugin.md) · INDEX · A bundle of skills, hooks, MCP servers, agents and output styles. See Plugins overview.
- [Remote session](nodes/term.remote-session.md) · SESSION · A session in a cloud environment or on another machine, driven by the claude-code-remote tools. See create_session.
- [Settings scope](nodes/term.settings-scope.md) · VERIFIED · The file a setting lives in: user, shared project, project local, or managed. See Settings file: user (~/.claude/settings.json) and Precedence rule.
- [Skill](nodes/term.skill.md) · VERIFIED · A folder with a SKILL.md file (frontmatter plus instructions) that runs as /name. Example: data:analyze.
- [Subagent](nodes/term.subagent.md) · VERIFIED · A child agent with its own context window, started by the Agent tool. It returns one final result. See Agent.
- [Teammate](nodes/term.teammate.md) · VERIFIED · An agent-team member, started by the Agent tool when agent teams are on. See Agent teams.
- [ToolSearch](nodes/term.toolsearch.md) · SESSION · The tool that loads deferred schemas, by exact name with select: or by keyword. See ToolSearch.
- [Workflow](nodes/term.workflow.md) · VERIFIED · A rerunnable script that runs many subagents. Opt-in. See Dynamic workflows.

## Hook events

- [ConfigChange](nodes/hook.config-change.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a config file changes during a session. Matchers: user_settings, project_settings, local_settings, policy_settings, skills. Exit 2 blocks the...
- [CwdChanged](nodes/hook.cwd-changed.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when the working directory changes, for example after cd. No matcher. Side effects only; stderr goes to the user.
- [DirectoryAdded](nodes/hook.directory-added.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a directory is added with /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root. Matchers: slash_command, register_repo_root. Exit 2 goes to the debug log.
- [Elicitation](nodes/hook.elicitation.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when an MCP server asks for user input during a tool call. Matcher: MCP server name. Output: action (accept, decline or cancel) and content. Exit 2...
- [ElicitationResult](nodes/hook.elicitation-result.md) · VERIFIED · Fires after the user answers an MCP elicitation, before the reply goes back. Matcher: MCP server name. Exit 2 turns the reply into a decline.
- [FileChanged](nodes/hook.file-changed.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a watched file changes on disk. Matcher: literal filenames such as .envrc|.env, using letters, digits, underscore and pipe only. Side effects only.
- [InstructionsLoaded](nodes/hook.instructions-loaded.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/*.md enters context. Matchers: session_start, nested_traversal, path_glob_match, include, compact. Side effects only....
- [MessageDisplay](nodes/hook.message-display.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when assistant message text is displayed. No matcher. Output displayContent changes the display only. Exit 2 shows the original text.
- [Notification](nodes/hook.notification.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when Claude Code sends a notification. Thirteen matcher types, such as permission_prompt and idle_prompt. Side effects only.
- [PermissionDenied](nodes/hook.permission-denied.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when auto mode denies a tool call. Matcher: tool name. Exit 2 is ignored. Output retry: true is ignored for denials without a classifier verdict.
- [PermissionRequest](nodes/hook.permission-request.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a tool call needs a permission decision. Matcher: tool name. Exit 2 is not honored; decide with decision.behavior (Output: PermissionRequest...
- [PostCompact](nodes/hook.post-compact.md) · VERIFIED · Fires after compaction completes. Matchers: manual, auto. Side effects only; stderr goes to the user.
- [PostModelSwitch](nodes/hook.post-model-switch.md) · VERIFIED · Fires after the session's model changes, including automatic changes. Matcher: canonical model name. Plain stdout is added to context. Input: Stdin: model...
- [PostToolBatch](nodes/hook.post-tool-batch.md) · VERIFIED · Fires after a parallel tool batch resolves, before the next model call. No matcher. Exit 2 stops the loop before the next model call. Top-level decision...
- [PostToolUse](nodes/hook.post-tool-use.md) · VERIFIED · Fires after a tool call succeeds. Matcher: tool name. Exit 2 does not block; stderr goes to Claude. Top-level decision block and additionalContext apply....
- [PostToolUseFailure](nodes/hook.post-tool-use-failure.md) · VERIFIED · Fires after a tool call fails. Matcher: tool name. Exit 2 does not block; stderr goes to Claude.
- [PreCompact](nodes/hook.pre-compact.md) · VERIFIED · Fires before context compaction. Matchers: manual, auto. Exit 2 blocks compaction. See Compaction.
- [PreModelSwitch](nodes/hook.pre-model-switch.md) · VERIFIED · Fires before a requested model switch applies. Matcher: canonical model name. Can block with exit 2, a permissionDecision of deny, or a top-level decision...
- [PreToolUse](nodes/hook.pre-tool-use.md) · VERIFIED · Fires before a tool call runs. Matcher: tool name. Exit 2 blocks the call. Decisions: allow, deny, ask or defer (Output: PreToolUse decision). A timeout...
- [SessionEnd](nodes/hook.session-end.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a session terminates. Matchers: clear, resume, logout, prompt_input_exit, other. Exit 2 shows stderr to the user only. Shares a 1.5 s budget,...
- [SessionStart](nodes/hook.session-start.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a session begins or resumes. Matchers: startup, resume, clear, compact, fork. Plain stdout is added to context. Handler types: command and...
- [Setup](nodes/hook.setup.md) · VERIFIED · Fires for --init-only, and for --init or --maintenance with -p. Matchers: init, maintenance. Side effects only.
- [Stop](nodes/hook.stop.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when Claude finishes responding. No matcher. Exit 2 blocks, so Claude keeps working. Top-level decision block applies. Input: Stdin: Stop and...
- [StopFailure](nodes/hook.stop-failure.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a turn ends because of an API error. Matchers: rate_limit, overloaded, authentication_failed, oauth_org_not_allowed, account_on_hold,...
- [SubagentStart](nodes/hook.subagent-start.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a subagent is spawned. Matcher: agent type, such as general-purpose, Explore, Plan, a custom name, or a plugin-scoped name. Output:...
- [SubagentStop](nodes/hook.subagent-stop.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a subagent finishes. Matcher: agent type. Exit 2 blocks, so the subagent keeps working. Input: Stdin: Stop and SubagentStop fields.
- [TaskCompleted](nodes/hook.task-completed.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a task is marked completed. No matcher. Exit 2 means the task is not completed. Output: stopReason.
- [TaskCreated](nodes/hook.task-created.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a task is created with TaskCreate (TaskCreate). No matcher. Exit 2 rolls the task back. A top-level decision block cancels it.
- [TeammateIdle](nodes/hook.teammate-idle.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when an agent-team teammate is about to go idle. Exit 2 keeps the teammate working. Output: stopReason. See Agent teams.
- [UserPromptExpansion](nodes/hook.user-prompt-expansion.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a user-typed command expands into a prompt. Matcher: command name. Exit 2 blocks the expansion.
- [UserPromptSubmit](nodes/hook.user-prompt-submit.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a prompt is submitted, before processing, including turns Claude starts itself. No matcher. Exit 2 blocks the prompt. Plain stdout is added to...
- [WorktreeCreate](nodes/hook.worktree-create.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a worktree is created by --worktree, isolation: worktree, or a background session. Replaces the default git behavior. Output: a path on stdout,...
- [WorktreeRemove](nodes/hook.worktree-remove.md) · VERIFIED · Fires when a worktree that a WorktreeCreate hook made is removed. Any non-zero exit fails the removal. JSON output is discarded.

## Settings files

- [Settings file: global config (~/.claude.json)](nodes/setting-file.global-config.md) · VERIFIED · Holds the sign-in session, MCP server configurations, per-project state such as trust decisions, and the global config keys that /config writes. Claude Code...
- [Settings file: managed](nodes/setting-file.managed.md) · VERIFIED · managed-settings.json and other managed sources apply to everyone the organization deploys them to. Use for security policy and compliance. See Precedence...
- [Settings file: project local (.claude/settings.local.json)](nodes/setting-file.project-local.md) · VERIFIED · Applies to you, in this project only. Claude Code keeps it out of git when it creates the file. A hand-made file needs its own .gitignore entry.
- [Settings file: shared project (.claude/settings.json)](nodes/setting-file.shared-project.md) · VERIFIED · Applies to everyone working in the folder. In a git repository, commit it so teammates get the same settings. Use for team permissions, hooks, plugins and...
- [Settings file: user (~/.claude/settings.json)](nodes/setting-file.user.md) · VERIFIED · Applies to you in every project on this machine. Use for personal preferences and your own permission rules. Never shared. See Precedence level 5: user.

## Precedence

- [Precedence level 2: command line](nodes/precedence.command-line.md) · VERIFIED · JSON passed with --settings for one session. It overrides the same keys in project and user files; keys it omits keep their file values. See --settings.
- [Environment variables are not a level](nodes/precedence.env-not-a-level.md) · VERIFIED · Each variable and key pair has its own rule. For example, ANTHROPIC_MODEL in the shell applies over the model key from any file, while...
- [List keys merge](nodes/precedence.lists-merge.md) · VERIFIED · List keys such as permissions.allow merge across files. Exceptions: fallbackModel takes the whole value from the highest file that defines it; modelPicker...
- [Precedence level 1: managed](nodes/precedence.managed.md) · VERIFIED · The highest level. Nothing in your own files or in --settings overrides a managed key. See Settings file: managed.
- [Managed exceptions](nodes/precedence.managed-exceptions.md) · VERIFIED · A few security-sensitive keys let a restrictive value from a lower scope win over a managed value. Example: Managed exception: disableClaudeAiConnectors.
- [Precedence level 3: project local](nodes/precedence.project-local.md) · VERIFIED · .claude/settings.local.json. See Settings file: project local (.claude/settings.local.json).
- [Precedence rule](nodes/precedence.rule.md) · VERIFIED · A key set at a higher level overrides the same key below it. List keys are the exception: they merge (see List keys merge).
- [Precedence level 4: shared project](nodes/precedence.shared-project.md) · VERIFIED · .claude/settings.json. See Settings file: shared project (.claude/settings.json).
- [Precedence level 5: user](nodes/precedence.user.md) · VERIFIED · ~/.claude/settings.json, the lowest level. See Settings file: user (~/.claude/settings.json).

## Permission modes

- [A glob or trailing slash directly under a shell variable](nodes/permission-mode.a-glob-or-trailing-slash-directly-under-a-shell-variable.md) · VERIFIED · example: `rm -rf "$DIR"/*`; why it counts: The command becomes a removal from the filesystem root when the variable is empty
- [A shell variable followed by one common top-level directory name, such as mnt, tmp, usr, or Users](nodes/permission-mode.a-shell-variable-followed-by-one-common-top-level-directory.md) · VERIFIED · example: `rm -rf "$TMPDIR/mnt"`; why it counts: When the variable expands empty, the command removes `/mnt`
- [A target that is only backslashes](nodes/permission-mode.a-target-that-is-only-backslashes.md) · VERIFIED · example: `rm -rf "\\"`; why it counts: Git Bash on Windows reads a lone backslash as the current drive's root, so the check applies on every platform
- [A target that is only the output of a command substitution, when the rm is recursive](nodes/permission-mode.a-target-that-is-only-the-output-of-a-command-substitution-w.md) · VERIFIED · example: `rm -rf "$(pwd)"`; why it counts: Claude Code can't check the target before the command runs

## CLI invocation forms

- [claude -c](nodes/cli-form.continue.md) · VERIFIED · Continues the most recent conversation in the current directory. See --continue (alias -c).
- [claude -c -p "query"](nodes/cli-form.continue-print.md) · VERIFIED · Continues the most recent conversation through the SDK.
- [claude "query"](nodes/cli-form.initial-prompt.md) · VERIFIED · Starts an interactive session with an initial prompt.
- [claude](nodes/cli-form.interactive.md) · VERIFIED · Starts an interactive session.
- [cat file](nodes/cli-form.pipe.md) · VERIFIED · claude -p "query" | Processes piped content in print mode.
- [claude -p "query"](nodes/cli-form.print.md) · VERIFIED · Queries through the SDK, then exits. See --print (alias -p).
- [claude -r "<session>" "query"](nodes/cli-form.resume.md) · VERIFIED · Resumes a session by ID or name, with a new prompt. See --resume (alias -r).

## Git and PR rules

- [Attribution in commits and PRs](nodes/git-rule.attribution.md) · SESSION · Commit trailers and PR footers follow the attribution reminder (Attribution reminder). GitHub comments end with the attribution footer. The trailer decision...
- [Develop on the designated branch](nodes/git-rule.designated-branch.md) · SESSION · Commit and push only to the designated branch, and create it locally if it does not exist.
- [Environment questions go to read_documentation](nodes/git-rule.env-docs.md) · SESSION · Questions about the container, connectors, network or sessions are answered by calling read_documentation first (read_documentation).
- [Never rewrite history](nodes/git-rule.no-history-rewrite.md) · SESSION · Never rewrite another author's branch history. Never stack commits on a merged PR's history: start a fresh change from the default branch, and keep any...
- [No model identifiers in pushed artifacts](nodes/git-rule.no-model-identifiers.md) · SESSION · Anything pushed to a repository carries no model identifiers. See D5: Model names are left out of the notes.
- [Open a ready PR after a push](nodes/git-rule.open-pr-after-push.md) · SESSION · After a push, open a ready-for-review pull request if none is open. A merged or closed PR does not count.
- [Human-facing outputs default to the outputs folder](nodes/git-rule.outputs-default.md) · SESSION · The user's preference: sustained human-facing materials go to /mnt/user-data/outputs by default. This session's git rules designate the repo branch instead...
- [Branch deletion through the git proxy](nodes/git-rule.push-delete-noop.md) · REPO · Observed: git push --delete through the session's proxy printed "Everything up-to-date" and deleted nothing (Observation: push --delete was a no-op).
- [Retry network failures with backoff](nodes/git-rule.push-retry.md) · SESSION · Retry network failures only, up to four times, with backoff of 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds. Other failures are reported, not retried.
- [Subscribe after creating a PR](nodes/git-rule.subscribe-pr.md) · SESSION · Subscribe to the PR's activity right after creating it, so CI and review events reach the session (subscribe_pr_activity).
- [No PR template in this repo](nodes/git-rule.template-check.md) · REPO · .github/ holds only workflows/, and the root has no PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE. The PR body is therefore free-form.
- [CI asserts the tree index](nodes/git-rule.tree-index-ci.md) · REPO · The README says CI asserts docs/TREE.md against bin/gen_tree.py, so regenerate it after adding files (Build the node set).
